title: Plain statements on first read
description: As a publication operator, I want Limatus to catch prose that imitates the texture of a person writing without carrying the content (metaphor in place of fact, riddle closers, punch-line rhythm, openings that lean on insider vocabulary), so machine-drafted copy is readable on first pass without each publication re-encoding the rule as regexes. Source rule: Pilobolus VOICE.md 'Hello, fellow humans' and Anth.us voice guide 'Plain statements on first read'. Not included: automatic rewriting of these findings beyond the existing options loop.
